title: "Experiment Ledger"
description: "A chronological record of what was tried, what each panel can support, and what decision followed."
---

::: {.lead}
The experiments narrowed the project toward a simple visual baseline with
specialist evidence routes. The strongest general comparison is frozen-30;
the smaller panels explain failures, compatibility, or routing and must not be
read as 2026 accuracy estimates.
:::

Use [Start Here](index.qmd) for the current recommendation and the [Code Map](code-map.qmd)
to find the implementation behind each workflow.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  J12[Jul 12<br/>field guide] --> J20[Jul 20<br/>readiness + gate]

```

Plain-text equivalent:

1. **July 12:** the field guide framed the problem and candidate architecture.
2. **July 20:** dataset readiness and the three-video compatibility gate made
   controlled local runs practical.
3. **July 21–24:** targeted audio/spatial work and protocol-v2 frozen-30
   established the baseline; transcript, failure, taxonomy, temporal, and model
   panels tested narrower routes.
4. **July 25:** Qwen3-Omni produced encouraging diagnostic quality but failed
   the strict 20-output contract; the independent human-oracle tier stayed
   blocked.

## Chronological ledger

### July 12 field guide

- **Tried:** synthesized the prior TRECVID landscape, open-model options,
  scoring constraints, and a staged evidence-first architecture.
- **Panel:** literature and prior-team evidence, not a local benchmark.
- **Learned:** the project needed observable, matched evidence before complex
  routing or training.
- **Decision:** keep the [field guide][field-guide] as background orientation,
  not current experiment status.
- **Limitation:** it predates every local result in this ledger and cannot pick
  today's baseline.
- **Evidence:** [field guide source notes][field-notes] and the later
  [repository recovery PR #21][pr21].

### Data readiness

- **Tried:** built resumable acquisition, source validation, shared-data
  linking, and label-isolated preparation seams.
- **Panel:** operational readiness, not answer-quality evaluation.
- **Learned:** the repository can prepare and audit local evidence without
  committing the competition dataset, media, transcripts, predictions, or
  logs.
- **Decision:** keep one ignored shared dataset and run preflight before
  inference; do not start a large acquisition or benchmark merely to inspect
  the repository.
- **Limitation:** readiness proves neither video availability for every future
  row nor 2026 answer quality.
- **Evidence:** [root operating boundary][readme], [download module][vqa-download],
  and [recovery PR #21][pr21].

### Three-video compatibility gate

- **Tried:** ran Qwen3.5, Molmo2, InternVL, MiniCPM-o, and Gemma through a common
  small gate on the local AMD/ROCm host.
- **Panel:** three deliberately different labeled 2025 examples.
- **Learned:** the family adapters could be made reproducible, but the panel was
  too small for model ranking; MiniCPM's initial selected-frame native-audio
  path also exposed a speech-row tensor-shape failure.
- **Decision:** retain Qwen3.5-4B with 12 uniform frames as the practical
  baseline and expand only through controlled workflows.
- **Limitation:** **compatibility-only**; not a statistical accuracy sample.
- **Evidence:** [three-video gate report][three-gate] and [recovered benchmark
  work in PR #21][pr21].

### Audio, spatial, and Seamless diagnostics

- **Tried:** added full Whisper large-v3 translation, question-guided spatial
  crops, and a SeamlessM4T-v2 translation on selected failures.
- **Panel:** two audio/spatial failures, then one speech failure.
- **Learned:** the transcript could change Qwen's answer and the crop could add
  pixels without making either answer correct; Seamless output was incomplete
  and the downstream answer remained wrong.
- **Decision:** stop these particular escalations; keep 12 frames as the simple
  baseline and require better routing evidence.
- **Limitation:** targeted **diagnostics**, not accuracy estimates; manual crops
  were not scale-ready.
- **Evidence:** [audio/spatial report][audio-spatial], [Seamless report][seamless],
  and [recovery PR #21][pr21].

### Frozen-30 protocol v2 {#frozen-30-protocol-v2}

- **Tried:** four matched VQA arms across 30 rows: Qwen3.5-4B with 12 uniform
  frames, Qwen with 24 uniform frames, MiniCPM-o 4.5 with audio disabled, and
  Qwen 12 plus quality-gated Whisper large-v3.
- **Panel:** 30 labeled 2025 training examples, balanced across five declared
  strata. The clean run produced **120 valid predictions** and **30 valid
  Whisper executions**.
- **Learned:** Qwen12+Whisper led exact match at **11/30** and token F1 at
  **0.506795**. MiniCPM audio-off led METEOR at **0.374089** and had the fastest
  outer wall. Global Qwen24 added **no exact answers** versus Qwen12.
- **Decision:** use Qwen12 as the accuracy baseline, MiniCPM audio-off as the
  fast alternate, and Whisper only through a separately reported route.
- **Limitation:** this is the strongest **verified** repository comparison, but
  it is descriptive model selection on 2025 training data—not a 2026 estimate.
- **Evidence:** [protocol-v2 report][frozen30] and [recovered benchmark work in
  PR #21][pr21].

### Automatic-transcript ablation {#automatic-transcript-ablation}

- **Tried:** compared identical 12-frame Qwen requests with and without a
  label-blind, quality-accepted Whisper large-v3 transcript.
- **Panel:** ten selected lexical-speech rows; all 20 predictions were frozen
  before scoring.
- **Learned:** manual accuracy rose from **4/10 to 7/10**, with **three rescues**
  and **no observed degradation**.
- **Decision:** retain quality-gated Whisper on lexical-speech routes and work
  next on transcript grounding plus non-lexical-vocalization rejection.
- **Limitation:** a selected ten-row diagnostic does not validate routing
  prevalence or global transcript use.
- **Evidence:** [automatic-transcript report][transcript], [closed issue #7][issue7],
  and [PR #9][pr9].

### Failure-selected Qwen3.6 and audio panel

- **Tried:** compared Qwen12, Qwen24, Qwen+Whisper, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, and
  MiniCPM audio-off/audio-on paths on known failures.
- **Panel:** **12 deliberately selected failures**, explicitly not an accuracy
  sample.
- **Learned:** Qwen24 and MiniCPM audio-off each scored **4C/4P/4W**;
  Qwen3.6 scored **3C/2P/7W**. Native audio helped some prosody and sound rows
  but harmed some temporal reasoning.
- **Decision:** do not promote Qwen3.6 or a global audio switch; retain a small,
  category-routed ensemble idea.
- **Limitation:** failure selection inflates the value of recovery behavior and
  cannot rank full-test systems.
- **Evidence:** [failure-panel report][failure-panel] and [recovery PR #21][pr21].

### Taxonomy audit

- **Tried:** audited prior systems and prompt wording to estimate which evidence
  routes might matter.
- **Panel:** **481 training questions** plus primary prior-system documentation.
- **Learned:** conservative lexical lower bounds found **71 counting**, **22
  spoken-language**, **20 sound/music**, and **15 visible-text** prompts.
- **Decision:** keep these as router-design seeds and stratification hints.
- **Limitation:** lexical lower bounds overlap, omit paraphrases, and do not
  validate routing prevalence.
- **Evidence:** [taxonomy audit][taxonomy] and the [evidence-routing plan from
  closed issue #4][issue4-plan].

### Directed temporal sampling

- **Tried:** replaced part of a 12-frame uniform sequence with
  question-directed temporal evidence while holding model and pixel bounds
  fixed.
- **Panel:** ten temporal rows.
- **Learned:** directed 12 **tied uniform 12** and **trailed uniform 24** in
  blinded C/P/W adjudication.
- **Decision:** stop the heuristic; it did not pass either promotion condition.
- **Limitation:** a small temporal diagnostic can reject this implementation,
  not every possible learned or question-directed selector.
- **Evidence:** [temporal report][temporal], [closed issue #8][issue8], its
  [conclusion audit in closed issue #13][issue13], and [PR #10][pr10].

### Dense-burst sampling

- **Tried:** compared uniform-24 against dense-burst-12 under a narrow temporal
  hypothesis.
- **Panel:** **two rows only**.
- **Learned:** uniform-24 was **2C/0P/0W** while dense-burst-12 was
  **0C/1P/1W**, comprising one **C→P** and one **C→W** regression.
- **Decision:** stop dense-burst-12; do not generalize from or expand the losing
  heuristic without a new design.
- **Limitation:** the panel is too small for prevalence or effect-size claims.
  No row identifiers, answers, predictions, paths, or raw artifacts are part of
  this report.
- **Evidence:** aggregate source digest
  `d4825b4530b181f1b4414552a80136e2f0e5a7ee64def23131d8c163acc458f1`
  and [closed issue #16][issue16].

### Phi and Gemma: compatibility, then semantic stop

- **Tried:** ran joint vision/audio contracts on Phi-4-multimodal-instruct and
  Gemma 3n, then corrected platform/output confounds and applied a predeclared
  answer-quality screen.
- **Panel:** three selected audio roles.
- **Learned:** compatibility and semantic quality separated cleanly. On the
  semantic gate, Gemma scored **1C/1P/1W** and Phi **0C/2P/1W**.
- **Decision:** neither model was promoted beyond three rows.
- **Limitation:** the counts are a semantic screen, not a general leaderboard;
  the earlier Gemma compatibility promotion is superseded.
- **Evidence:** [compatibility report][nonqwen], [semantic correction][semantic],
  [closed issues #6][issue6] and [#12][issue12], plus [PR #11][pr11] and
  [PR #15][pr15].

### Qwen3-Omni compatibility and quality-10

- **Tried:** repaired the joint runtime/output contract, then compared 12-frame
  frames-only and native-audio conditions on a ten-video neutral quality panel.
- **Panel:** three-row compatibility screen, then ten matched pairs.
- **Learned:** the final three-row compatibility run passed the runtime/output
  contract and scored **1C/1P/1W**; that made it a candidate, not a baseline.
  In neutral A2, a post-hoc answer-only diagnostic changed frames-only
  **3C/3P/4W** to audio-on **5C/2P/3W**.
- **Decision:** promising, but formally ineligible: the unchanged strict A2 run
  completed only **19/20** outputs.
- **Limitation:** the recovered answer is diagnostic only, one reviewer was not
  blinded, and 2026 answer quality remains unknown.
- **Evidence:** [compatibility report][qwen-compat], [neutral A2 report][omni-a2],
  [closed issues #5][issue5] and [#17][issue17], [PR #14][pr14], [PR #18][pr18],
  and recovery [PR #20][pr20].

### Human-oracle tier

- **Tried:** specified a separate provenance tier for independently created and
  reviewed human transcripts; automatic ASR, uploader captions, and dataset
  prompts were explicitly kept out of that tier.
- **Panel:** none—the strict tier did not run.
- **Learned:** the required independent transcriber/reviewer records do not yet
  exist.
- **Decision:** keep the human-oracle tier **blocked** in [open issue #19][issue19].
- **Limitation:** there is no oracle result to compare or cite.
- **Evidence:** [transcript-evidence report][transcript], [open issue #19][issue19],
  and the reconciled [evidence-routing plan][issue4-plan].

## What superseded what

| Earlier statement or result | Superseding evidence | Current interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| July 12 architecture priorities | Executed panels through July 25 | Background field guide only; use this ledger for current status. |
| Failure panel favored global Qwen24 | Frozen-30 protocol v2 | Qwen12 is the global default; 24 frames added no exact answers. |
| Whisper as a broad additional modality | Frozen-30 plus automatic-transcript ablation | Route only to quality-gated lexical speech. |
| Initial Gemma compatibility promotion | Phi/Gemma semantic gate | Stop both at three rows; compatibility is not quality. |
| Qwen3-Omni compatibility success | Neutral quality-10 A2 | Promising but ineligible after 19/20 strict outputs. |
| Directed and dense temporal heuristics | Their matched diagnostic panels | Stop both implementations. |

The next work should close the gaps rather than repeat a superseded default;
see [Code Map and Remaining Gaps](code-map.qmd#remaining-gaps).
